strongest_case: The strongest defensible case for V2 is that it preserves the scientifically honest and potentially useful object while repairing several real V1 governance and attribution hazards: a deterministic finite synthetic action-conditioned-memory construct; representation-neutral legal-action scoring; physical unpadded-stream-first AS-CTX and an OLD-support embargo; target-blind prospective/revision text compilation with immutable lineage-local instances; treatment unmount before common-prior-plus-public-delta reconsolidation; complete failure inclusion; a premodel/post-B3 chronology split; held-out shortcut falsification; faithful native backends with separate capability and resource estimands; explicit policy-prior and wrong-life controls; and a five-way descriptive terminal vocabulary with no automatic successor. The exact title and thesis correctly frame any eventual output as a protocol plus an eight-root DEV stress test, not population efficacy, formal mediation, general continual learning, LoRA value, or current C1--C5 evidence. A complete null, native-backend dominance, or a renderer limitation could still be a useful method/benchmark result. T01's total allocation/context rules and T02's finite world/action, recurrent-versus-nonadaptive, and representation-neutral headroom rules are particularly defensible prospective construct gates. All of this is specification, not evidence or authority. The strongest case does not overcome the exact-byte contradictions below: as written, V2 cannot simultaneously execute its roster, enforce its visibility/capability ontology, reproduce its namespace, or deterministically classify every trace.

concerns.statement: Executing both separately named AS-EXT candidates through every full B3 cell is arithmetically incompatible with the frozen 908-row/root and 7,264-row total roster.
concerns.evidence: The retained experiment_contract.md Section 6 says the 908-row surface has six full-surface arms, with one frozen AS-EXT. statistics_and_claim_contract.md Section 1 derives 908 as 768 ordinary current-snapshot rows plus 92 P1, 36 P2, and 12 P3 rows. The target schedule gives 128 ordinary target rows per full-surface arm: 12 pre-native rows, 108 post-native NEW/OLD/CROSS rows, and 8 A4 rows. V2 T05, T08, T15, T18, fork_assignment_and_phase_split_contract.md Sections 5--6, and paper_result_and_successor_contract.md Sections 1 and 3 instead require both AS-EXT candidate series across all B3 cells while retaining 908. Seven full-surface arms produce 896 ordinary rows; 896+92+36+12=1,036 rows/root and 8,288 over eight roots. Treating two condition-specific outcomes/failures as one row would violate complete failure-inclusive reporting. Required resolution: either update every roster, resource, completion, test, and release count to 1,036/8,288, or select one AS-EXT by an outcome-independent pre-B3 contest and run only that candidate on the 908-row B3 surface; do not count two full candidate series as one condition.

concerns.statement: The post-B3 AS-EXT designation is not reporting-only because it is an input to the favorable/null classifier.
concerns.evidence: T05 permits a frozen selector only after both candidates seal and says it cannot alter P1--P4 or evidence. T15 proves only that disposition cannot reach B3 bytes or completion logic. But paper_result_and_successor_contract.md Section 4.2 favorable sign 2 compares SELF to the AS-EXT series designated only after all B3 cells seal. The retained baseline_and_resource_manifest.md Section 2 chooses that series by observed mean cross-era AUC, then resources/tie-breaking. Therefore changing the selected identity can change FAVORABLE_DESCRIPTIVE versus PROCEDURALLY_COMPLETE_NULL on the same raw data without changing any B3 byte. The matrix also gives POST_B3_REPORTER_SELECTOR visible PRIOR_RESULTS, RESOURCE_AUDIT, timing/failure data, full SCHEDULE_AND_CLOCK_STATE, and full A2_PREMODEL_CONFIGURATION rather than only registered hashes/aggregates, enlarging the result-conditioned surface. Required resolution: freeze an outcome-independent primary comparator before B0 or classify conservatively against every candidate/the strongest candidate, remove POST_B3_DEV_DISPOSITION from every sign and classifier input, reduce selector reads to exact registered derivatives, and mutation-test terminal-class invariance.

concerns.statement: The active retention-noninferiority/retention-NI name contradicts the proposal's exact no-inference language lock even though the underlying arithmetic is only a finite deterministic tolerance component.
concerns.evidence: statistics_and_claim_contract.md Section 3 defines the descriptive component as L_w-A_w+0.05 and repeatedly calls it retention-NI. V2 T06 carries 'retention-NI component', and paper_result_and_successor_contract.md Section 4.2 calls it a '.05 retention-noninferiority component'. The same paper contract Section 6 forbids any noninferiority statement, and T16 requires every active name/path/status to match descriptive nonclaim semantics. The math can remain, but the active inferential term is internally inconsistent and rhetorically claim-bearing. Required resolution: rename it everywhere active as a finite retention-tolerance descriptive sign, bind the deterministic root-vector rule, and make T06/T16/T20 reject 'NI' or 'noninferiority' outside separately ratified future inferential provenance.

concerns.statement: The 27-by-8 Cartesian field/stage matrix is not a closed executable visibility contract because the component universe and total component-to-stage projection remain open and contradictory.
concerns.evidence: V2 validates 216 cells over 27 information items and eight coarse stages, but the retained visibility_taint_reset_contract.md Section 2 requires distinct generator, opportunity allocator, target allocator/certifier, renderer, ordinary actor, environment executor, extractor, Dream-1, Dream-2, sleeper/compiler, reader, evaluation installer/actor, scorer, resource auditor, selector, and terminal analyst components in addition to fork roles. No closed registry or total projection assigns these components to the eight stages. The failure is functional, not cosmetic: HIDDEN_TRUTH_AND_TARGET_ALLOCATION is forbidden to B3_COGNITIVE_AND_TARGET_PATH and visible only to TERMINAL_AUDITOR, leaving no named environment/scorer execution path; ARM_AND_CAPACITY_ASSIGNMENT lacks an ordinary trusted installer; scheduler/renderer and resource-auditor roles are absent. field_information_ontology_contract.md Section 4 calls its reader column a maximum, yet the JSON matrix grants terminal-auditor PUBLIC_OPPORTUNITY/PUBLIC_LIVED_EVENT access and broad SCHEDULE_AND_CLOCK_STATE access beyond 'scheduler/renderer only'. T07 asks for a complete component matrix that the proposal does not supply. Coarse full-class grants, including visible A2 bytes to B3/selector/auditor, cannot enforce each component's least-privileged subset. Required resolution: bind a closed component registry and either a full field-by-component matrix or an exact total component-to-stage projection followed by per-component policy intersection; add every missing executor/auditor/router role, reconcile the Section-4 maxima with JSON, and validate exact Cartesian coverage over the closed component set.

concerns.statement: The ontology cannot deterministically generate stable field IDs or prove its stated U_inst=E_inst equality from the present definitions.
concerns.evidence: field_information_ontology_contract.md Section 2 defines closed bundle B to include the ontology manifest, field registry, schema set, acceptance gates, and a change.json that binds them; Section 3 then defines field_uid using bundle_hash. If bundle_hash covers those generated registry bytes, identity is self-referential. No pre-registry digest domain or canonicalization exclusion is named. U_def also includes 'contract-declared serialization' from Markdown prose, for which no canonical traversal exists. Section 7 defines U_inst across success, NULL, malformed, timeout, denied, reset, crash, unavailable, and terminal paths, but E_inst is one execution's emitted/observed set; mutually exclusive alternatives cannot all occur in one trace, and a crash may require a supervisor-owned planned slot. COMPOUND_RESTRICTED is forbidden to every stage in the JSON matrix while the contract anticipates later positive-reader amendments, so ordinary combined-taint objects can neither execute nor remain under the ratified closed matrix. Required resolution: define a canonical schema-set prehash that excludes generated IDs/registry bytes, make machine-readable schemas plus an explicit prose-to-schema inventory the sole U_def domain, require U_inst(trace)=E_inst(trace) per trace with a separately defined suite-union coverage set for alternatives/crashes, and derive compound permissions directly from source-taint intersections without a future matrix amendment.

concerns.statement: Nonreifiable, unforgeable, noncopyable write-only capabilities and total descendant destruction are assertions, not constructible boundaries, without a threat model, trusted computing base, and logical-destruction definition.
concerns.evidence: fork_assignment_and_phase_split_contract.md Sections 2--3 require separate processes and a nonserializable capability with no compare/copy/destination-discovery operation, yet a Python object is addressable/introspectable and an interprocess token is represented by an OS/network handle. Section 3 introduces a routing fabric that necessarily sees route metadata but is absent from the eight-stage matrix and role registry. T14 asks mutation trials to hold one-use capability tokens fixed, which is impossible after install_once; only fresh matched tokens/public transcripts can be compared. field_information_ontology_contract.md Section 6 and the fork contract require descendants, caches, errors, timing, provider state, and objects to be 'destroyed', but immutable-language copies, allocator memory, OS caches/logs/crash dumps, and remote-provider retention cannot be physically certified by an application receipt. TERMINAL_AUDITOR is nevertheless visibly granted live EXPLORATION_CAPABILITY_AND_HANDLE_METADATA after the declared destruction point, despite a separate absence-receipt class. Required resolution: specify adversary/non-collusion assumptions and a minimal broker/TCB; isolate processes/containers and bind syscall, IPC, file, log, cache, crash-dump, and network policies; use fresh broker-owned one-shot handles and compare canonical public transcripts; define destruction as revocation plus worker teardown and bounded non-reachability; and exclude providers whose retention/cache contracts cannot meet that boundary.

concerns.statement: The proposal alternates between paired canonical seed equality and exact common random draws index by index; the former does not establish the latter on ordinary provider inference.
concerns.evidence: mediation_contract.md Section 3 derives P1_COMPILER_SEED by SHA-256 and a Stage-A2 digest-to-provider-seed conversion, while T03, T07, T12, compiler_memory_contract.md, and visibility_taint_reset_contract.md require paired compiler draws to be identical index by index. Equal request seeds do not prove identical underlying uniforms when provider versions, kernels, cache state, request order, stopping lengths, or distributed nondeterminism differ. Different output lengths can also consume a sequential PRNG differently. V2 does not bind a sampler that exposes or logs counter-indexed draws or a fixed consumption rule. Required resolution: for true common random numbers, bind a pinned local deterministic sampler with logged counter-based uniforms indexed by pair/sample/token position and fixed stopping/consumption goldens; otherwise rename every obligation to paired canonical seed/request equality and forbid claims of exact shared draws.

concerns.statement: The exact current bytes cannot pass their own graph/test/claim semantic lint because V2 binds only V1 namespace/applicability artifacts and retains contradictory active IDs, paths, literals, and result states.
concerns.evidence: The only bound claim_namespace_map.json and claim_test_applicability.json both have V1 change_id and name retired PAS_T06_LIFETIME_STATISTICS_POWER_AND_PLATEAU, PAS_T09_A4_REVISION_SENTINEL, and PAS_T10_CONDITIONAL_LORA_READER_AND_CAUSAL_SENTINEL. No V2 namespace/applicability files exist. T10 requires the evidence value literal NO_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED but declares NO_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED:NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D. T11 returns DESCRIPTIVE_COMPLETE, NULL, NOT_RUN, or REJECT, conflicting with T20's exact NOT_RUN, REJECT, STOP_TEXT_ORGAN_INVALID, FAVORABLE_DESCRIPTIVE, and PROCEDURALLY_COMPLETE_NULL vocabulary. T03 writes to artifacts/pcfl_active_stream/confirm/randomized_unmounted_mediation.json, while T16 and paper_result_and_successor_contract.md Section 5 reject active confirmation-bearing paths. The retained T03 ID is required by rework_disposition.md Section 4, but without a mandatory presentation alias/qualifier its bare 'MEDIATION' term conflicts with the repeatedly stated non-formal causal-cascade meaning. Required resolution: add hash-bound V2 namespace/applicability artifacts with exact claim/test set equality; make T10's evidence field exactly NO_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED with status separate; update T11 to the five V2 terminal classes; move T03 evidence to a descriptive causal-cascade path; and, if the immutable T03 ID remains, bind a mandatory display alias and linted 'not formal mediation' qualifier.

concerns.statement: T04 conflates compiler/control conformance with a favorable efficacy sign, making a valid complete null fail procedural validity.
concerns.evidence: T04's expected result requires generic SELF to add directional value beyond controls and lose value under interventions. V2's graph, paper_result_and_successor_contract.md Section 4, and T20 say favorable B3 signs are not part of procedural validity and that a complete valid surface lacking any sign is PROCEDURALLY_COMPLETE_NULL. Since the procedural-completion node also requires every construct/control gate, treating all of T04.expected as pass/fail collapses null into STOP_TEXT_ORGAN_INVALID. The retained B1/B2 spending gates may legitimately stop expansion before B3, but their pre-B3 promotion signs must be distinguished from B3 conformance and from the post-completion descriptive classifier. Required resolution: split T04 into a sign-independent integrity/conformance predicate and separately recorded descriptive signs; define B1/B2 promotion/early-stop predicates separately; and prove that a complete correctly measured unfavorable B3 observation remains procedurally valid and classifies null.

concerns.statement: The advertised complete terminal machine omits legal exits and makes independent review both a prerequisite and a classifier, so it cannot emit exactly one result for every trace.
concerns.evidence: paper_result_and_successor_contract.md Section 7 has INCOMPLETE_AFTER_DISPATCH only from B0_IN_PROGRESS; B1_IN_PROGRESS, B2_IN_PROGRESS, and B3_IN_PROGRESS lack general abort/missing-work exits. REJECT exists only from B3 even though provenance or claim-lint rejection can occur before or outside B3. Section 4.1 makes VALID_B1_B3_PROCEDURAL_COMPLETION depend on an independent reviewer accepting the exact descriptive/defer label, while the result-classification loop triggers only after that reviewer issues a disposition and is supposed to derive the label. Completeness rejection also competes with missing-cell organ invalidity under the precedence. RENDERER_BOUNDARY is forced to be a null subtype even though renderer sensitivity can coexist with all five favorable signs. These cycles/gaps defeat T20's exclusivity and T21's exhaustive enumeration. Required resolution: publish a deterministic state/event transition table with incomplete/abort/reject/stop exits from every phase and explicit precedence; separate PROCEDURE_SEAL, independent review, and terminal classification into an acyclic order; and make renderer limitation an orthogonal tag on either valid complete outcome.

concerns.statement: The shortcut, one-return, and model-owned-path gates can be finite empirical falsifiers, but the exact current bytes do not define the algorithms, thresholds, or aggregation needed to execute them.
concerns.evidence: T17 and shortcut_resource_policy_attribution_contract.md Section 2 enumerate useful strata but do not bind the held-out root/renderer roster, attack generator, predictor families, training seeds, selection rule, exact solution threshold, or root/stratum reducer. A finite audit cannot prove absence of every pretrained semantic shortcut and must be stated only over its frozen domain. Section 3.3 asks whether natural-language content plus goal/state 'determines' a probe or complete trajectory for an exact typed controller, but gives no deterministic decision procedure for a stochastic language controller. Section 3.4 defines MEMORY_DEPENDENT_PATH_USE by one query/action being a function of an earlier return without an exact logged dataflow/counterfactual predicate, and MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE requires undefined 'directional separation' from controls. T02's nonadaptive/headroom certificate is defensible only when its finite controllers and thresholds are bound in the same operational manner. Required resolution: freeze a finite audit domain, seeds, models, controller builds, typed decision predicates, thresholds, root/stratum aggregation, and failure rules; instrument return-to-query/action dataflow or exact counterfactual path tests; define the control-separation inequality; and limit every absence claim to the predeclared audit surface.

concerns.statement: The partial-dominance rule is undefined when a declared coordinate is NOT_MEASURED or measured under incomparable accounting.
concerns.evidence: shortcut_resource_policy_attribution_contract.md Section 5 makes missing mandatory coordinates RESOURCE_INCOMPLETE, but also permits unavailable energy as NOT_MEASURED and defines dominance as no greater consumption on every mandatory resource coordinate. It never says whether a NOT_MEASURED coordinate is mandatory/applicable, whether one-sided missingness makes a pair incomparable, or when a coordinate can be prospectively excluded for both methods. Units, precision/rounding, measurement boundary, shared-cost allocation, concurrency attribution, and comparison tolerance are also not fixed. T18's expected text repeats both 'complete coordinates' and 'missing energy is NOT_MEASURED', so two implementations can produce different frontiers from the same observations. Required resolution: freeze units, direction, precision/rounding, measurement boundaries, shared-cost/concurrency allocation, and a pairwise applicability mask before B0; make any applicable NOT_MEASURED coordinate render the pair incomparable/ineligible, and allow exclusion only when prospectively declared for both configurations and reported.

concerns.statement: The wrong-life and raw-evidence controls run only on B1/B2 gate items, while B3 release language permits model-owned-path descriptions without specifying whether those controls cover the B3 rows.
concerns.evidence: shortcut_resource_policy_attribution_contract.md Section 1 and T19 restrict MISBOUND_MEMORY and RAW_EVIDENCE_POLICY to assigned B1/B2 gate roots/items and explicitly add no B3 target row. But change.json claim_delta says B3 may describe MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE, the causal-cascade loop says to report it separately, T06 requires terminal/path diagnostics in the complete eight-root release, and paper_result_and_successor_contract.md Section 3 requires path-use diagnostics in the B3 release. Because MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE by definition additionally requires separation from both controls, it is undefined for an uninstrumented B3 row/root. B1/B2 evidence can validate plumbing but cannot silently be projected to eight-root B3 attribution. Required resolution: either restrict MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE reporting and language to the instrumented B1/B2 items while B3 reports only supported terminal/memory-dependent quantities, or preassign failure-inclusive matched controls for every B3 attribution label and update the row/resource ledger accordingly.

concerns.statement: Ratifying the exact current scope would be an architecture receipt only and would authorize no post-ratification implementation or fixture work.
concerns.evidence: scope_proposal.json requests only non-scientific deliberation-role calls through human_required, forbids every implementation and CPU fixture, and says later implementation requires a new exact SHA-bound scope and explicit human ratification. By the time the decision owner can ratify, those role calls are complete. The V2 graph has a future associative-deliberation request but no nonauthorizing request edge for a narrowly bounded A0--A2 implementation/test scope. This is safe and may be intentional, but it does not advance the construct along AGENTS.md's ratification -> scoped implementation -> independent review sequence and leaves T12--T19 necessarily NOT_RUN until another intake is authored. Required resolution: either explicitly label this decision a governance receipt and add a nonauthorizing MAY_REQUEST_SCOPED_A0_A2_IMPLEMENTATION next step with an exact follow-on scope, or submit a repaired narrowly enumerated A0--A2 implementation/CPU-fixture scope for human decision while keeping B0/model/provider/GPU science separately gated.

concerns.evidence: T01: conditionally constructible and scientifically well motivated, pending a machine-readable finite schema/component closure. T02: conditionally constructible, pending exact finite controller and shortcut predicates. T03: REWORK for 908-row inconsistency, active confirm/mediation semantics, and draw-versus-seed ambiguity. T04: REWORK to separate conformance from favorable signs. T05: REWORK for two-candidate row arithmetic and result-conditioned comparator use. T06: REWORK for roster arithmetic, retention-NI naming, and attribution/resource completeness. T07: REWORK because the component universe, destruction semantics, and true paired randomness are not closed. T08: REWORK for roster/resource inconsistency and a nonactionable current scope. T09: specification acceptable only after a V2 namespace projection exists. T10: exact current declaration FAILS its required literal. T11: FAILS current V1 namespace and stale terminal vocabulary. T12: conditionally constructible only after runtime/TCB and RNG meanings are bound. T13: not constructible until digest, schema traversal, per-trace equality, compound taint, and component closure are repaired. T14: not constructible until the broker/TCB, fresh matched token mutation, routing role, and logical destruction are defined. T15: chronology is sound but FAILS classifier invariance/least-privilege as written. T16: the current bytes FAIL their own semantic lint. visibility_failures: The matrix is Cartesian only over 27 declared fields and eight coarse stages; it has no closed executable-component registry or total component-to-stage projection.

HIDDEN_TRUTH_AND_TARGET_ALLOCATION has no authorized environment/scorer execution reader, while ARM_AND_CAPACITY_ASSIGNMENT has no ordinary installer reader and scheduler/renderer/resource-auditor roles are absent.
The field contract's maximum-reader table conflicts with positive JSON cells, including terminal-auditor access to public events and broad non-scheduler access to SCHEDULE_AND_CLOCK_STATE.

POST_B3_REPORTER_SELECTOR can see full PRIOR_RESULTS, failures, schedule, resources, timing, and A2 configuration rather than only the closed registered aggregate/hash derivatives needed for reporting.
TERMINAL_AUDITOR can see EXPLORATION_CAPABILITY_AND_HANDLE_METADATA after the same handles are required destroyed; only sealed assignment records and destruction/absence receipts should survive.
The privileged routing fabric required to transfer write-only capabilities is outside the stage/component policy and therefore outside T07/T13 exact Cartesian coverage.
COMPOUND_RESTRICTED is forbidden to every stage while the ontology anticipates later positive-reader amendments, so combined-taint fields cannot execute under the supposedly closed current matrix.

A non-self-referential ontology prehash/canonical-schema inventory test with per-trace planned-versus-emitted equality and separate suite-union failure-path coverage.
A named adversary/TCB/broker test defining capability guarantees, fresh matched-token trials, syscall/IPC/log/cache boundaries, and logical revocation/process-teardown destruction.
Either a golden counter-indexed local common-random-number sampler test or a semantic downgrade test proving only paired canonical seed/request equality.
A V2-native claim namespace/applicability exact-set test covering all current IDs, the T10 literal, T11 terminal vocabulary, and the T03 display/path non-formal-cascade qualifier.
A gate-layering test proving B3 conformance passes for both favorable and null observations while any B1/B2 spending stop remains separately classified.
A mechanically exhaustive, deterministic, acyclic terminal transition-table test covering abort/incomplete/reject/stop events at every phase and orthogonal renderer limitation tags.
A finite shortcut/path audit manifest fixing rosters, algorithms, predictor families, seeds, thresholds, dataflow IDs, counterfactuals, aggregation, and the bounded conclusion.
A Pareto comparability test fixing units, direction, precision, measurement boundaries, shared-cost allocation, pairwise applicability, and NOT_MEASURED handling.
An attribution-scope test that either limits MODEL_OWNED_PATH_USE to instrumented B1/B2 items or supplies frozen failure-inclusive controls for every B3 attribution label.

Will the terminal classifier use a pre-B0 primary comparator or the conservative strongest of both AS-EXT candidates, with POST_B3_DEV_DISPOSITION provably restricted to display/planning only?
Will V2 define a closed executable-component registry and a concrete isolated-process broker/TCB with logical revocation/teardown, or require a stronger capability runtime and local-only backend?
Does exact paired RNG mean logged token-position common random numbers under a pinned deterministic sampler, or only equal canonical provider seed/request fields with correspondingly weaker language?

Will the active namespace, T03 path/display term, T10 literal, T11 states, retention-tolerance name, conformance/result separation, terminal transition table, shortcut/path algorithms, Pareto missingness, and B3 attribution scope be repaired in new exact bytes before ratification?

Is the intended human decision deliberately an architecture-only governance receipt, or should a new exact scope authorize a narrowly enumerated A0--A2 implementation and CPU-fixture phase while retaining separate B0/scientific/GPU authority?

Does the decision owner confirm that the current proposal, either interpretation, and this critique authorize no implementation, fixture, scientific call, CPU/GPU run, Stage C/D work, LoRA work, publication, claim, or successor launch?
